text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, propranolol hydrochloride 40 mg tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 92 tablets (7.5 days at 12.3 tablets per day). Corvale General holds 425 tablets (29.3 days at 14.5 tablets per day). All inventory is labeled by Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407) per NDC 71335236909.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 590126 at the Bryant Ranch Prepack facility ended 2009-06-11 and was classified OAI, with the classification known on 2009-09-09. A Warning Letter was issued to the same facility on 2010-04-08. The most recent inspection (1326578) ended 2026-07-16 and was classified VAI, with the classification known on 2026-10-14.

Our position: Supply at Corvale East is below two weeks. Corvale General has sufficient stock to support a transfer while maintaining adequate days on hand. The drug is not in shortage per FDA.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 81 tablets of 40 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval for the transfer request.
2. Evaluate purchase from AMICI PHARMACEUTICALS LLC if transfer is insufficient — needs buyer approval.
3. Evaluate purchase from Amneal Pharmaceuticals NY LLC if needed — needs buyer approval.
4. Evaluate purchase from AvPAK if needed — needs buyer approval.
5. Evaluate purchase from Ipca Laboratories Limited if needed — needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
